description: This file defines a ThunderJS module that manages API requests, plugin registration, event listening, and resource cleanup. It exports a default function for initializing the module with options, and includes internal methods for handling promises, event listeners, and proxy-based method delegation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures the result is a promise and optionally calls a callback if provided.

methods.name: wrapper
methods.description: Creates a proxy to wrap an object, enabling dynamic method resolution and plugin context management.

methods.name: ensurePluginContext
methods.description: Prepares method arguments by adding plugin or context identifiers based on the method name.
